data.long_meaning: Lorinda is derived from the Greek name 'Lorinda', meaning 'bright, famous'. In Greek mythology, the name is associated with the goddess of light, Aphrodite. In Christian tradition, Lorinda represents faith, grace, and purity. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lorinda usually hope their child will grow to embody light, famous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word 'loros' (sea) or 'lima' (deep) and 'nda' (mother, lady), meaning 'deep sea' or 'lady of the deep waters'.

in_latin.name: Lorinda
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word 'lorus' (reclining) or 'lux' (light) and 'inda' (intense, profound), meaning 'restful' or 'intense light'.

in_english.name: Lorinda
in_english.long_meaning: An English name derived from the Old English 'hlor' (pure) and 'rind' (dear, lovely), meaning 'pure, lovely one'.
